question: What claim about agency must hold for the yoginī named Wish to extend up to Māyā by the siddhas through supreme will?
premises: The yoginī named Wish is present.
This is done by the siddhas through supreme will.
inference: By supreme will, the siddhas cause the yoginī named Wish to extend up to Māyā.
uncertainties: The exact mode of extension is not specified.
plain_english: The yoginī named Wish, by the siddhas, extends up to Māyā by supreme will.
